subject: Operations
title: Cyber Risk in Global Operations
description: A fast breakdown of Cyber Risk in Global Operations for builders.

hook.text: The NotPetya cyberattack shut down Maersk's shipping operations for two weeks. Global trade lost $10 billion.

buildup.text: Global operations depend on interconnected IT systems. A cyberattack on one node can cascade through the entire network.

discovery.text: Ransomware, data breaches, and system disruptions can halt production, logistics, and financial transactions.

twist.text: Attackers target the weakest link—often a small supplier with minimal security protecting access to the larger network.

climax.text: Companies now require cyber standards from suppliers and segment networks so a breach in one area doesn't spread.

punchline.text: Your security is only as strong as your weakest partner's.

quiz.question: Why do cyberattackers target small suppliers?
